listing.name: Armour Visualiser
listing.summary: does what it says on the tin. (and also weapon arcs) updated for .98, no crashes afaik, yell at me if it does
listing.aiSummary: Visualises ship armour coverage and weapon arcs.

description: Displays overlays showing armour zones and weapon firing arcs on ships. Includes a visualiser for escort package range. Keybinds are configured in the LunaSettings menu.
